page.overview:
What is Wrackspurt?

A Wrackspurt was an invisible magical creature which floated into a person's ears, making their brain become unfocused and confused.

Supposedly, Wrackspurts could be seen with aid of Spectrespecs.

In the 1989–1990 school year, Badeea Ali claimed the Hog's Head Inn was infested with Wrackspurts. This, however, was actually a distraction so Jacob's sibling could put on their Invisibility Cloak without Aberforth Dumbledore noticing. In 1998, The Quibbler reported that some Wrackspurts broke out of the Ministry Elfin' Safety Enquiry.

Xenophilius Lovegood's attempt to recreate Rowena Ravenclaw's Diadem included Wrackspurt siphons "to remove all sources of distraction from the thinker's immediate area". Once in Diagon Alley, Luna Scamander suggested to a muddled student that there might be Wrackspurts flying around their head.
